name: tmux-pair
description: Run a single coding agent on a task via tmux + git worktree. /run is the auto-entry: short repo + task recon, then dispatches to /solo. /solo runs one agent in a fresh worktree with a gated 7-phase workflow (Recon -> Clarify -> Reviewer-Readiness -> Plan-Check -> Loop -> Final-Verify -> Auto-Squash-Merge), adversarial review at each gate via parallel claude-subagent + `codex exec` (two independent minds, no pane setup), mandatory PROJECT.md care, explicit parallel-plan markers, scoped plugin-agents for the gates (reviewer-readiness-check + rules-bootstrap on Sonnet, gate-2-plan-check on Sonnet, gate-3-verifier on Haiku, gate-3-code-reviewer on Sonnet), shipped rules templates for 7 stacks (Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, JavaScript, Java, generic), bundled companion skills (gepa for prompt-optimization, dg for adversarial code review), durable standards via claude --append-system-prompt-file + codex AGENTS.md, model-aware compact-watcher with /compact [focus] support, and mandatory Post-Merge Retro that persists recurring patterns. Phase 7 (new in 0.20.0): the solo agent squashes its bullet commits onto the base branch, deletes the feature branch, removes the worktree, and pings DONE-MERGED, so sequential chained runs always start from a clean base instead of stacking on a previous feature branch. Multi-pane spawn modes (writer + reviewer panes, dual-review, parallel-writers) were removed in 0.19.0: shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR contention, git-index-lock races, cross-writer PROJECT.md races, and dual-review coordination consistently outweighed the parallelism gain. Default model claude-opus-4-7 (1M context, override per spawn via --claude-model + --claude-effort + --codex-effort). Default agent claude; `/run` dynamically picks claude vs codex based on task profile (claude for recon-heavy / plan-integration / greenfield / compliance; codex for single-file edits / mechanic refactors / adversarial bug-hunt with gpt-5.5+xhigh); user can pass --agent pi explicitly for cost-sensitive bulk work. The same claude-vs-codex heuristic applies inside the solo run to subagent spawns: `Agent(...)` (claude Task tool) for recon-heavy / plan-driven sub-bullets, `Bash(codex exec --cd <sub-wt>)` for single-file / mechanic / adversarial sub-bullets. Phase 1 (Recon) defaults to claude subagents; Phase 3 (Impl) picks per parallel sub-bullet profile; Phase 2/4 (Gates) already runs both minds in parallel.

interface.shortDescription: Single coding agent in a fresh git worktree with gated 7-phase workflow (incl. auto-squash-merge) and parallel claude + codex adversarial review
interface.longDescription: Run a single agent in a fresh git worktree with a gated 7-phase self-driven workflow (Recon -> Plan-Check -> Impl -> Final-Verify -> Persist -> Commit -> Auto-Squash-Merge). Each gate runs two independent minds in parallel: a claude subagent plus `codex exec` (different model family, fresh context, no pane setup). Phase 7 (new in 0.20.0) auto-squashes bullet commits onto base, deletes the feature branch, removes the worktree, and pings DONE-MERGED so sequential chained runs always start from a clean base. Includes PROJECT.md care, sender identity prefixes, parallel-plan markers, bundled skills (gepa, dg), and helper scripts. /run auto-entry performs a short recon, then dispatches to /solo. Defaults stay slim with optional --with-standards and --greenfield briefing extras.
defaultPrompt: Spawn a solo agent with gated self-review on this task.
Use tmux-pair orchestration for this repo.
